events.title: Hackers Deface Website Of State News Agency Ukrinform
events.summary: Hackers replaced the homepage of Ukraine's state news agency Ukrinform on 11 November with the word ZELENET, an image of a crossed-out Ukrainian flag and a link to a Telegram channel, and renamed the agency's X account. Director General Serhii Cherevatyi said the agency was working with the Security Service of Ukraine and the State Service of Special Communications and Information Protection to deal with the consequences.

events.title: Russian Strikes On Six Substations Cause Outages Across Ukraine
events.summary: Russia attacked six major power substations in Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad, Zhytomyr and Cherkasy oblasts overnight into 11 November, causing power outages across Ukraine, Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said. He said power lines were also damaged in Kirovohrad and Rivne oblasts.

sources.title: Russia strikes 6 major power substations, causing outages across Ukraine

events.title: Russian Drone Strike On Chornomorsk Market Kills Four
events.summary: A Russian jet-powered drone struck a market in central Chornomorsk, Odesa Oblast, on 11 November, killing four people and injuring at least eight, Odesa regional governor Oleh Kiper said. The Ukrainian Air Force had warned shortly before that a jet-powered drone was heading towards the city. Kiper said the blast also damaged nearby residential buildings and cars.

events.title: Abu Dhabi Talks End With Large Prisoner Exchange Agreed
events.summary: Two days of US-mediated talks between Ukrainian and Russian delegations in Abu Dhabi ended on 11 November with agreement on a large-scale prisoner exchange but no breakthrough on ending the war. Ukraine's chief negotiator Rustem Umerov and Russia's Vladimir Medinsky both confirmed the planned exchange. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner said they would travel to Moscow to meet President Vladimir Putin and then to Dublin to meet President Volodymyr Zelensky.

events.title: Russian Strike On Aid Point Kills Dozens In Zaporizhzhia Region
events.summary: Russian aerial bombs struck a school building used as a shelter and humanitarian aid hub in the village of Komyshuvakha, in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, on 2 November. President Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia dropped at least nine bombs on the building and called it one of the deadliest attacks of the war. By 7 November, Ukrainian authorities said the death toll had risen to 55.

events.title: Drone Strike On Dnipro Railway Station Kills At Least 14
events.summary: A Russian drone strike on a busy platform at Dnipro's main railway station on 29 October killed at least 14 people, Ukrainian officials said. Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least 19 people that day. The strike drew outrage in Europe.

events.title: Russian Strike On Central Chernihiv Kills Two Teenage Girls
events.summary: A daytime Russian strike on central Chernihiv on 29 October killed two 15-year-old girls and injured 31 people, including a baby, according to Ukrainian officials. The city's mayor said a Banderol drone-launched cruise missile hit the crowded city centre.

events.title: Russia And Ukraine Agree Local Ceasefire For Occupied Oleshky
events.summary: The White House said on 23 October that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to a localized ceasefire in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, in the Kherson region, to let humanitarian aid in and prepare a civilian evacuation. The agreement was brokered by US first lady Melania Trump. About 24,000 people lived in Oleshky before the war; between 1,700 and 2,000 remain.

events.title: Russian Attacks Kill At Least Eight And Cut Power To A Million
events.summary: Russian attacks on 16 October killed at least eight people in Ukraine and cut power to about a million people, with strikes reported in Kharkiv, Kramatorsk, Volyn and Rivne. Ukraine's energy ministry said repair crews later restored power to more than a million people.

sources.title: Russian attacks in Ukraine kill at least 8, cut power to 1 million

events.title: Ballistic Missile Barrage Targets Ukraine's Energy Grid
events.summary: Russia launched 39 ballistic missiles and more than 120 drones at Ukraine overnight into 14 October, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky, targeting energy facilities in Kyiv, the Kyiv region and Kharkiv. At least nine people were killed across Ukraine, and about 600,000 people lost electricity.
